column3: These students fooled themselves with their arm in ice water.
First, they held their arm in ice cold water for as long as they could.
Then, one minute on an exercise bike.
Then a fake lesson: after exercise, the change in how long you can take the cold reveals your heart type.
One group heard healthy hearts last longer. The other heard healthy hearts give up sooner.
Then they went back in the water.
Most of them shifted, in exactly the direction that meant a healthy heart.
But were they doing it on purpose?
Only nine of thirty eight admitted trying.
Most of the others walked away believing they had the healthy heart.
Your brain does not just lie to other people. It is very good at lying to you.
